race.comment: LIKA REMI (10) in career best form and chasing her third straight win today. Returned from a let-up when she swamped them late for a comfortable win over 1004m at Port Macquarie. Looks ready for this trip and gets the right set-up again. VARUNI (11) lightly raced filly who returns for her second prep. Went out a winner with a sharp victory over this track and trip last October. Fitted with the two trials and looks set for a good campaign. JENNI LA ROCK (9) drifted back early and failed to make an impression second-up with a battling fifth over 1300m at Scone. Second run for the new yard and keep safe. NUGGET SMART (17) going better than his recent runs suggest. Goes into the exotics.
